search_window.basis: Started at independently read-back-verified latest Food Line watch heartbeat completed_at on ops/watch-ledger; classified by publication and event time, not crawler date.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value miss-class recall only; authoritative nationwide Food Line production collection unchanged.
target_classes: Only/sole/last/full-service community grocery loss, closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended because of storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank service closure or major immediate access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruption with immediate food-access consequences

coverage_notes.observation: Twelve bounded targeted searches yielded no independently verified new U.S. disruption published or materially updated since the 18:49 PST prior completed check. Results principally repeated the previously recorded Provo, Utah closure, a September 2026 sole-grocery fire in Spencer, New York, and October 2025 SNAP shutdown notices. No new agency/provider SNAP or WIC interruption, qualifying emergency-distribution cancellation, or novel pantry closure was verified.

excluded_examples.title: Provo food bank announces temporary closure amid financial shortfall
excluded_examples.reason: Previously recorded Community Action Services and Food Bank closure in Provo; already excluded by preceding heartbeat as duplicate.

excluded_examples.title: Nonprofit temporarily closes its doors, impacting more than 20,000
excluded_examples.reason: Same previously known Provo closure, original report predates search window.

excluded_examples.title: Town of Spencer recovering after losing only grocery store in fire
excluded_examples.reason: Qualifying class but historical September 2026 incident, not newly reported in current window.

excluded_examples.title: Governor Murphy, Senate President Scutari, and Assembly Speaker Coughlin Announce Accelerated Delivery of $42.5 Million in Food and Hunger Grants
excluded_examples.publisher: New Jersey Department of Human Services
excluded_examples.reason: Historical 2025 SNAP program interruption and grants, not a new 2026 immediate-access development.

duplicate_screen.method: Fetched most recent branch-head commit and prior heartbeat with the GitHub connector, and compared incident/source dates with its known exclusions.

coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded web search is not exhaustive; same-hour local notices may not yet be indexed. No findings does not establish absence of events. A public GitHub page browser fetch failed, but direct GitHub connector reads succeeded and source searches remained usable.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, public publication, production collection, schedule modification, or task disabling.
